sql: SELECT sum(events) OVER () AS population_count, dataset, lines_read, events, rejected, strftime(first_ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS first_event, strftime(last_ts, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS last_event, error_events, patterns, single_event_patterns, time_basis, label_source, levels, components, labels, api_accesses, api_accesses_without_request_id, requests FROM corpus_stats ORDER BY dataset
SELECT dataset, component, team, note FROM ownership ORDER BY team, dataset, component
SELECT dataset, field, events_with_value, distinct_values, examples FROM corpus_field_stats ORDER BY dataset, field
SELECT data_version, source, loader_version, parser_version, pattern_rules_version, ownership_version, rules_version FROM load_manifest

datasets.title: BGL
datasets.origin: BlueGene/L supercomputer at Lawrence Livermore National Labs, 2005–2006.
citation: Jieming Zhu, Shilin He, Pinjia He, Jinyang Liu, Michael R. Lyu: Loghub: A Large Collection of System Log Datasets for AI-driven Log Analytics. ISSRE 2023.
Adam Oliner, Jon Stearley: What Supercomputers Say: A Study of Five System Logs. DSN 2007.
datasets.time_basis: Unix seconds (UTC) + microseconds of the text timestamp
datasets.label_source: alert category in the first column (dataset label)

fields.meaning: Stable event ID: the line number.
Hash of dataset, component and normalised message (R-04).
Event time, UTC with microseconds.
Severity as logged: INFO, WARNING, SEVERE, ERROR, FATAL, FAILURE.
BGL component (KERNEL, APP, …).
BGL message type (RAS, …).
Original log message after the header fields, untrusted text.
Error level after R-02.
Node ID, e.g. R02-M1-N0-C:J12-U11.
Midplane derived from the node, e.g. R02-M1.
Rack derived from the node, e.g. R02.
Dataset alert category; null for non-alert lines.

datasets.title: OpenStack
citation: Jieming Zhu, Shilin He, Pinjia He, Jinyang Liu, Michael R. Lyu: Loghub: A Large Collection of System Log Datasets for AI-driven Log Analytics. ISSRE 2023.
datasets.label_source: instances with injected anomalies, anomaly_labels.txt (dataset label)

fields.meaning: Stable event ID: 10,000,000 + running line number over the files in load order.
Hash of dataset, component and normalised message (R-04).
Event time, UTC with microseconds.
Severity as logged: INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL.
OpenStack service from the file prefix (nova-api, …).
OpenStack logger name.
Original log message after the header fields, untrusted text.
Error level after R-02.
Request ID (req-…) of the request block.
Instance UUID named in the line.
HTTP method of an API access line.
API path with IDs masked (R-04).
HTTP status of an API access line.
Response time of an API access in milliseconds.
Dataset anomaly label of the instance, where assignable.

capabilities.error_definition: levels ERROR, CRITICAL; failed API accesses are 5xx

limits: No shared time axis: no two datasets overlap as systems, BGL (2005–2006) and OpenStack (2017) not even in time; Apache and Linux overlap BGL's calendar but are other systems with unknown time zones. Trends, period comparisons, context and precursors are per dataset; numbers across datasets are totals over each full span and are labelled as such.
Logs only: there is no business, customer, cost or downtime data. Such impact is unknown and must be named as unknown.
Labels belong to the dataset: BGL alert categories, OpenStack instance and HDFS block anomaly labels are not findings of this system; cite them as dataset labels.
Matches are log entries: counted events, patterns and episodes are neither incidents nor outages.
Times without a zone in the log are assumed UTC, and missing years (OpenSSH, Linux) are inferred from the data; time_basis names the assumption per dataset.
